title.narrative: Protecting freedom of expression and strengthening civic space in Pakistan

description.narrative:
The overall objective of this action is to create a stronger civic space equipped to promote and protect human rights and fundamental freedoms in Pakistan.

The specific objective is to create pathways for the media and human rights defenders to access information, engage in dialogue on human rights and democratic concerns, safely express dissent or disagreement, and articulate collective views. This is better specified in following expected outcomes of the action:

Outcome 1: A more empowered civil society able to advocate and protect people¿s rights, based on credible documentation and evidence.

Outcome 2: More effective realisation of fundamental freedoms for all citizens, particularly the most vulnerable.

Outcome 3: A state better equipped to achieve its human rights commitments.
